title: EmbodiExp: Compositional Experience Transfer for Embodied Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.39180v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Experience can help embodied agents turn high-level plans into grounded actions, but transferring it across tasks remains challenging: previously effective strategies may be inapplicable to the current state or fail to produce their intended outcomes. We present EmbodiExp, a framework for constructing transferable experiences and composing them online during embodied task execution. Our key observation is that tasks often share subgoals whose completion can be assessed independently of overall task success. We therefore introduce an outcome-grounded subgoal experience that specifies a subgoal, applicability conditions, an adaptable policy, and a verifiable outcome. During execution, applicable experiences guide action generation, while verified outcomes can establish the conditions required by subsequent experiences, enabling online composition. Subgoal-level outcome attribution further enables failure utilization: failed trajectories

translated_title: EmbodiExp：面向具身智能体的可组合经验迁移
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.39180v1 公告类型：cross 摘要：经验可以帮助具身智能体将高层规划转化为落地动作，但跨任务迁移经验仍然充满挑战：先前有效的策略可能不适用于当前状态，或者无法产生预期的效果。我们提出 EmbodiExp，一个用于构建可迁移经验并在具身任务执行过程中在线组合这些经验的框架。我们的关键观察是：任务往往共享一些子目标，而这些子目标的完成情况可以独立于整体任务的成功与否进行评估。因此，我们引入了一种以结果为依据的子目标经验，它明确了子目标、适用条件、可调整的策略以及可验证的结果。在执行过程中，适用的经验引导动作生成，而经过验证的结果可以建立后续经验所需的条件，从而实现在线组合。子目标层面的结果归因进一步实现了对失败的利用：失败的轨迹……
tldr: EmbodiExp 提出一种以结果为依据的子目标经验表示，使具身智能体能够在任务执行过程中在线组合与迁移经验，并借助子目标层面的结果归因来利用失败轨迹。
en_tdlr: EmbodiExp introduces outcome-grounded subgoal experiences that embodied agents can compose online during task execution, enabling cross-task experience transfer and failure utilization through subgoal-level outcome attribution.
